name: Grilled Salmon with Mango Salsa
desc: Chili and garlic rubbed salmon grilled and topped with a fresh mango, red pepper, jalapeno and cilantro salsa.

source.title: Grilled Salmon with Mango Salsa
source.evidence: Identical ingredient list and amounts (4 6-oz fillets, 1 tsp each garlic and chili powder, juice of 1 lime, 2-3 mangoes, 1/2 red pepper, 1/2 red onion, 1 small jalapeno, 1/4 cup cilantro) and the same three steps.

ingredients.raw: 1 tbsp vegetable oil, for the grill grates
1 small jalapeno, seeded and finely chopped
1/4 cup packed fresh cilantro leaves, roughly chopped

steps: Stir the mango, red pepper, onion, jalapeno, and cilantro together in a medium bowl. Set aside.
Preheat the grill to medium heat and oil the grates.
Stir together the garlic powder, chili powder, salt, and pepper and rub it over the salmon.
Grill the salmon 6-8 minutes per side, until it flakes easily and the thickest part reads 145°F. (Or bake on a lined sheet pan at 450°F for about 15 minutes.)
Squeeze the lime juice over the salmon, top with the mango salsa, and serve.
tips: Thinner 6 oz fillets can be done in less time; Kalejunkie cooks similar fillets about 6 minutes on the first side and 5 to 6 on the second, so check the temperature early.
